description: Evaluation suite for the sea-freight skill. Cases are stored in reference/golden.jsonl; this file defines how they are scored. The suite weights documentation and Incoterms correctness heavily because errors in these areas cause customs holds, cargo release failures, and uninsured losses.

baseline.notes: Baseline set on 2026-10-09. Any category that falls below its baseline blocks merge. Any category raised above its baseline must be justified in the PR description and the baseline updated in the same commit.

scoring.rationale: Ocean freight decisions are consequential and must be deterministic given the same inputs. A booking prepared with the wrong Incoterms or the wrong container is a commercial and operational defect.
scoring.notes: Critical-failure list is strict. A shipment prepared with the wrong Incoterms risk point or with an undetected insurance gap is a commercial defect that would only surface at claim time.

categories.description: Documentation validation, BOL fields, DG declaration, UN/LOCODE validity.
Incoterms resolution, container suitability, risk-cost divergence, insurance obligation.
Container selection, utilization, weight limits, special equipment.
Insurance gap detection, demurrage exposure, carrier-liability analysis.
Cases that should trigger a guardrail must return GUARDRAIL_PENDING rather than a decision.
Cases where the skill must refuse: sanctions, missing DG declaration, insurance absent under buyer-risk Incoterms.

harness.notes: The runner asserts that no case calls a procedure outside the skill's scope list, in addition to scoring the output.
